acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or refute the reported evidence-only multi-session progress parking; retain exact ticket/runtime/handoff and fingerprint bindings.
An owner-accepted numbered contract chooses a bounded explicit progress signal, preserving separation from role matching and ensuring duplicate/stale evidence does not manufacture progress.

Regression covers genuine changed evidence or file content, unchanged signals, missing/malformed inputs, cooldown/parking and restart continuity; retain focused checks, independent review, CEM/OCM, integration and native completion.
body:
Owning GitHub issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/468 (reported against main-25ba271). Reporter evidence and requested behavior:

## Problem

`corvint-tasks dispatch` parks tickets that are making real progress, when that progress lives outside the queue.

The progress fingerprint (CAL-V0-057, `Fingerprint` in `internal/tasks/dispatch/roster.go`) covers the ticket's status, revision and work state, plus attempts that carry durable work: a candidate, gates, reviews or a durable phase. A worker that does a session of real work and then hands off with the clean external hand-off `release --reason HANDOFF --evidence <ref>` (#421) leaves none of those. Its work is commits on a WP branch, documents and an updated status file, and the hand-off records no candidate. The dispatcher counts the run as "no progress", cools the ticket down, and parks it after `parkAfter` runs.

Observed on 2026-10-01 at 23:38Z (`main-25ba271`): `INV-1`, a multi-session inventory WP, was parked ("3 dispatcher run(s) made no progress"), although each of those sessions committed partial inventory and rewrote its status file. Every long-running WP in a program like ours hits this eventually.

Our workaround is in our `workState` command: it appends a variant suffix (`work~3` and so on), derived from the WP status file's mtime, so that a changed status file changes the work state. Every role then has to list all the variants.

## Request

Let the program declare progress explicitly. Any one of these would do:
- the `workState` command may return `{"state": "...", "progress": "<opaque token>"}` per ticket, and the token is folded into the fingerprint but never matched by roles;
- count a hand-off whose `--evidence` reference differs from the previous one as progress, possibly behind a per-role `progressOnEvidence: true`;
- optional `progressPaths` per role (like `activityPaths`), whose content hash is folded into the fingerprint.


Status: reported defect, not independently reproduced in this intake. Current installed Tasks build202 does not establish behavior of the reported source snapshot.

Original reported source/runtime identity is retained separately; this filing is not a new reproduction or passing test. Native export/targeted literal dedupe found no dedicated equivalent. title: Reported dispatch defect: progress fingerprint ignores evidence hand-offs and file-based work, so multi-session WPs get parked
